metaDescription: beehiiv is a newsletter platform with a website, growth tools, ad network and paid subscriptions. See its features, Launch, Scale, Max and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: beehiiv is a newsletter platform built for growth. It combines newsletters, a website and podcasts in one place, with unlimited email sends, campaign analytics, custom domains, an AI website builder and a recommendation network to grow your audience.

Paid plans add ways to earn, such as the ad network, paid subscriptions and boosts, plus referral programs, automations and advanced analytics. Prices rise with your subscriber count. The free Launch plan supports up to 2,500 subscribers, and Enterprise covers lists of 100,000 or more.

features.title: Newsletters and website
features.text: Publish newsletters, a website and podcasts from one platform.

features.title: Unlimited sends
features.text: Send as many emails as you like, with optimised deliverability, on every plan.

features.title: Growth tools
features.text: A recommendation network on Free, plus referral programs and boosts on paid plans.

features.title: Monetisation
features.text: Earn with the ad network and paid subscriptions, from the Scale plan.

features.title: Automations and analytics
features.text: Automations, A/B testing and advanced analytics on paid plans.

features.title: API and MCP
features.text: API access and beehiiv MCP, with read access on the free plan.

useCases: Earning from ads and paid subscriptions
strengths: A free plan for up to 2,500 subscribers with unlimited sends.
Newsletter, website and podcast in one platform.
Built-in monetisation through ads and paid subscriptions.
A recommendation network to grow your list.
limitations: The free plan is capped at 2,500 subscribers.
Monetisation, automations and advanced analytics need Scale or higher.
Prices rise with your subscriber count.
Removing beehiiv branding needs the Max plan.

pricing.summary: Free Launch plan. Paid plan prices depend on your subscriber count; prices below are starting prices, billed monthly, with yearly billing cheaper (Scale $43/mo, Max $96/mo).
